title: Samba NDR PULL SVCCTL StartServiceW Heap Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Samba. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within Samba's handling of a NDR PULL SVCCTL StartServiceW request. By sending a specially crafted packet, it is possible to cause Samba to use a different size for memory allocation than it uses for a memory copy loop. This can result in memory corruption, and may be exploited by an attacker to gain remote code execution.
